title: •Weapons Display
caption: •Weapons Display (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Whenever opponent excludes any character(s) from battle, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent’s turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and a system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and did not initiate a battle, you may retrieve 1 Force.
lore: The X-wing’s display panel allows for different firing patterns for different weapons. This gives the pilot the ability to switch weapon types with minimum time and energy loss.

Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the Special Edition form, '1998' legible.
